versions.changelog: Desensitize: extract ablation config to external file

Initial release of Agent Self-Evolution.

- Introduces a framework for automated evaluation and self-improvement of AI agents.
- Supports golden test sets to catch regressions and track performance.
- Includes ablation testing to identify critical and redundant configuration components.
- Enables multi-dimensional evaluation with tracking over time.
- Provides automated improvement loops for agent optimization.
- Includes setup instructions and real-world findings from agent ablation.
